name: stg_niif_caratula
description: Filing cover sheet attributes (company name, CIIU, department, city, restatement flag). The API returns U+FFFD for accented letters, shown here as "?".
sql:
-- description: Filing cover sheet attributes (company name, CIIU, department, city, restatement flag). The API returns U+FFFD for accented letters, shown here as "?".
SELECT
    nit_normalize(r.nit) AS nit,
    year(r.fecha_corte::TIMESTAMP)::INTEGER AS fiscal_year,
    r.numero_radicado AS filing_radicado,
    m.line AS attribute,
    clean_label(r.valor) AS value_text,
    CASE
        WHEN nit_normalize(r.nit) IS NULL THEN 'invalid_nit'
        WHEN m.line IS NULL THEN 'unmapped_concept'
    END AS _reject_reason
FROM {{ source('supersoc_niif_caratula') }} r
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('seed_concept_map') }} m ON m.source_id = 'supersoc_niif_caratula' AND r.concepto LIKE m.pattern
WHERE r.periodo = 'Periodo Actual'

name: stg_niif_facts
description: NIIF income-statement, balance-sheet and operating-cash-flow facts of the allowlisted concepts. Typed, scope and framework decoded from the entry point, concept mapped to a statement line. Exact upstream duplicates are kept here and removed in int_filing_lines.
sql:
-- description: NIIF income-statement, balance-sheet and operating-cash-flow facts of the allowlisted concepts. Typed, scope and framework decoded from the entry point, concept mapped to a statement line. Exact upstream duplicates are kept here and removed in int_filing_lines.
SELECT
    nit_normalize(r.nit) AS nit,
    year(r.fecha_corte::TIMESTAMP)::INTEGER AS fiscal_year,
    r.fecha_corte::TIMESTAMP::DATE AS cutoff_date,
    r.numero_radicado AS filing_radicado,
    e.framework,
    e.statement_scope,
    clean_label(r.concepto) AS concept_label,
    m.line,
    m.priority::INTEGER AS priority,
    CASE r.periodo WHEN 'Periodo Actual' THEN 'current' WHEN 'Periodo Anterior' THEN 'prior' END AS period_kind,
    thousands_to_cop(r.valor) AS value_cop,
    r.source_id,
    CASE
        WHEN nit_normalize(r.nit) IS NULL THEN 'invalid_nit'
        WHEN e.code IS NULL THEN 'unknown_entry_point'
        WHEN m.line IS NULL THEN 'unmapped_concept'
        WHEN r.periodo NOT IN ('Periodo Actual', 'Periodo Anterior') THEN 'unknown_period'
        WHEN thousands_to_cop(r.valor) IS NULL THEN 'unparseable_value'
    END AS _reject_reason
FROM (
    SELECT 'supersoc_niif_income' AS source_id, nit, numero_radicado, punto_entrada, fecha_corte, concepto, periodo, valor FROM {{ source('supersoc_niif_income') }}
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'supersoc_niif_balance', nit, numero_radicado, punto_entrada, fecha_corte, concepto, periodo, valor FROM {{ source('supersoc_niif_balance') }}
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'supersoc_niif_cashflow', nit, numero_radicado, punto_entrada, fecha_corte, concepto, periodo, valor FROM {{ source('supersoc_niif_cashflow') }}
) r
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('seed_concept_map') }} m ON m.source_id = r.source_id AND r.concepto LIKE m.pattern
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('seed_entry_point_map') }} e ON e.code = regexp_extract(r.punto_entrada, '^[0-9]+', 0)

description: 10,000 largest companies, typed. Money text "$ 100.59" (trillions of COP, two decimals) becomes COP pesos; NIT is digits only.
sql:
-- description: 10,000 largest companies, typed. Money text "$ 100.59" (trillions of COP, two decimals) becomes COP pesos; NIT is digits only.
SELECT
    nit_normalize(nit) AS nit,
    TRY_CAST(a_o_de_corte AS DECIMAL(6, 2))::INTEGER AS fiscal_year,
    clean_label(raz_n_social) AS company_name,
    supervisor,
    clean_label(regi_n) AS region,
    clean_label(departamento_domicilio) AS department,
    clean_label(ciudad_domicilio) AS city,
    ciiu_normalize(ciiu) AS ciiu,
    clean_label(macrosector) AS macrosector,
    money_trillions_to_cop(ingresos_operacionales) AS revenue_cop,
    money_trillions_to_cop(ganancia_p_rdida) AS net_income_cop,
    money_trillions_to_cop(total_activos) AS total_assets_cop,
    money_trillions_to_cop(total_pasivos) AS total_liabilities_cop,
    money_trillions_to_cop(total_patrimonio) AS total_equity_cop,
    CASE
        WHEN nit_normalize(nit) IS NULL THEN 'invalid_nit'
        WHEN TRY_CAST(a_o_de_corte AS DECIMAL(6, 2)) IS NULL THEN 'invalid_fiscal_year'
        WHEN money_trillions_to_cop(ingresos_operacionales) IS NULL OR money_trillions_to_cop(ganancia_p_rdida) IS NULL
          OR money_trillions_to_cop(total_activos) IS NULL OR money_trillions_to_cop(total_pasivos) IS NULL
          OR money_trillions_to_cop(total_patrimonio) IS NULL THEN 'unparseable_money'
    END AS _reject_reason
FROM {{ source('supersoc_top10k') }}

description: Official COP/USD exchange rate (TRM) with its validity window. Weekend and holiday rates span several calendar days.

-- description: Official COP/USD exchange rate (TRM) with its validity window. Weekend and holiday rates span several calendar days.
SELECT
    vigenciadesde::TIMESTAMP::DATE AS valid_from,
    vigenciahasta::TIMESTAMP::DATE AS valid_to,
    TRY_CAST(valor AS DOUBLE) AS trm_cop,
    CASE
        WHEN TRY_CAST(valor AS DOUBLE) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(valor AS DOUBLE) <= 0 THEN 'invalid_rate'
        WHEN vigenciahasta::TIMESTAMP < vigenciadesde::TIMESTAMP THEN 'inverted_validity_window'
    END AS _reject_reason
FROM {{ source('superfinanciera_trm') }}

name: int_company_lines
description: Statement lines pivoted wide, one row per current filing (nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope). Values are COP pesos from the current period; revenue_prior is the comparative column of the same filing.
sql:
-- description: Statement lines pivoted wide, one row per current filing (nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope). Values are COP pesos from the current period; revenue_prior is the comparative column of the same filing.
SELECT
    filing_id, nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, framework,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'revenue') AS revenue,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'cost_of_sales') AS cost_of_sales,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'gross_profit') AS gross_profit,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'admin_expenses') AS admin_expenses,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'selling_expenses') AS selling_expenses,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'operating_income') AS operating_income,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'finance_income') AS finance_income,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'finance_costs') AS finance_costs,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'profit_before_tax') AS profit_before_tax,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'income_tax') AS income_tax,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'net_income') AS net_income,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'total_assets') AS total_assets,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'current_assets') AS current_assets,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'cash') AS cash,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'receivables') AS receivables,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'inventories') AS inventories,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'ppe') AS ppe,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'total_liabilities') AS total_liabilities,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'current_liabilities') AS current_liabilities,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'noncurrent_liabilities') AS noncurrent_liabilities,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'total_equity') AS total_equity,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'current' AND line = 'operating_cash_flow') AS operating_cash_flow,
    max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE period_kind = 'prior' AND line = 'revenue') AS revenue_prior
FROM {{ ref('int_filing_lines') }}
GROUP BY filing_id, nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, framework

name: int_department_region
description: Most frequent region of each department among the 10,000 largest companies (ties broken alphabetically). Classifies companies that only have a department name.
sql:
-- description: Most frequent region of each department among the 10,000 largest companies (ties broken alphabetically). Classifies companies that only have a department name.
SELECT upper(department) AS department, region, count(*) AS observations
FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }}
WHERE department IS NOT NULL AND region IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY upper(department), region
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY upper(department) ORDER BY count(*) DESC, region) = 1

name: int_filing_lines
description: Statement-line facts of the current filings, long format, one row per (filing, line, period). Exact upstream duplicates collapse here; when two concepts feed one line the lower priority number wins.
sql:
-- description: Statement-line facts of the current filings, long format, one row per (filing, line, period). Exact upstream duplicates collapse here; when two concepts feed one line the lower priority number wins.
SELECT
    v.filing_id, v.nit, v.fiscal_year, v.statement_scope, v.framework,
    f.line, f.period_kind, f.value_cop
FROM {{ ref('stg_niif_facts') }} f
JOIN {{ ref('int_filing_versions') }} v
  ON v.nit = f.nit AND v.fiscal_year = f.fiscal_year AND v.statement_scope = f.statement_scope AND v.filing_radicado = f.filing_radicado
WHERE v.is_current
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY v.filing_id, f.line, f.period_kind ORDER BY f.priority, f.value_cop) = 1

name: int_filing_versions
description: One row per submitted NIIF filing, ranked within (nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope). The highest numero_radicado among plausible filings is current; the rest are recorded as superseded. A filing is rejected as a suspected pesos-for-thousands unit error when its total assets exceed 100x an independent witness of the same NIT-year: the comparative the next year's filing reports (same scope when available, otherwise the largest of any scope), the 10,000-largest record (individual and separate statements), or the earliest version of the same filing.
sql:
-- description: One row per submitted NIIF filing, ranked within (nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope). The highest numero_radicado among plausible filings is current; the rest are recorded as superseded. A filing is rejected as a suspected pesos-for-thousands unit error when its total assets exceed 100x an independent witness of the same NIT-year: the comparative the next year's filing reports (same scope when available, otherwise the largest of any scope), the 10,000-largest record (individual and separate statements), or the earliest version of the same filing.
WITH filings AS (
    SELECT
        nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, framework, filing_radicado,
        max(value_cop) FILTER (WHERE line = 'total_assets' AND period_kind = 'current') AS total_assets_cop
    FROM {{ ref('stg_niif_facts') }}
    GROUP BY nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, framework, filing_radicado
),
next_year_comparative AS (
    SELECT nit, fiscal_year - 1 AS fiscal_year, statement_scope, max(value_cop) AS comparative_assets
    FROM {{ ref('stg_niif_facts') }}
    WHERE line = 'total_assets' AND period_kind = 'prior'
    GROUP BY nit, fiscal_year - 1, statement_scope
),
any_scope_comparative AS (
    SELECT nit, fiscal_year, max(comparative_assets) AS comparative_assets
    FROM next_year_comparative
    GROUP BY nit, fiscal_year
),
earliest_version AS (
    SELECT nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, min(filing_radicado) AS first_radicado, arg_min(total_assets_cop, filing_radicado) AS first_assets
    FROM filings
    GROUP BY nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope
),
checked AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        CASE
            WHEN f.total_assets_cop > 100 * coalesce(s.comparative_assets, a.comparative_assets) AND coalesce(s.comparative_assets, a.comparative_assets) > 0
                THEN 'suspect_unit_vs_next_year_comparative'
            WHEN f.statement_scope IN ('individual', 'separate') AND f.total_assets_cop > 100 * t.total_assets_cop AND t.total_assets_cop > 0
                THEN 'suspect_unit_vs_top10k'
            WHEN f.filing_radicado > e.first_radicado AND f.total_assets_cop > 100 * e.first_assets AND e.first_assets > 0
                THEN 'suspect_unit_vs_earlier_version'
        END AS _reject_reason
    FROM filings f
    LEFT JOIN next_year_comparative s ON s.nit = f.nit AND s.fiscal_year = f.fiscal_year AND s.statement_scope = f.statement_scope
    LEFT JOIN any_scope_comparative a ON a.nit = f.nit AND a.fiscal_year = f.fiscal_year
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_top10k') }} t ON t.nit = f.nit AND t.fiscal_year = f.fiscal_year
    LEFT JOIN earliest_version e ON e.nit = f.nit AND e.fiscal_year = f.fiscal_year AND e.statement_scope = f.statement_scope
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        nit || ':' || filing_radicado AS filing_id,
        nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, framework, filing_radicado, total_assets_cop,
        row_number() OVER w AS version_rank,
        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope) AS n_versions,
        row_number() OVER w = 1 AS is_current,
        CASE WHEN row_number() OVER w > 1 THEN first_value(filing_radicado) OVER w END AS superseded_by_radicado
    FROM checked
    WHERE _reject_reason IS NULL
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope ORDER BY filing_radicado DESC)
)
SELECT *, NULL::VARCHAR AS _reject_reason FROM ranked
UNION ALL BY NAME
SELECT nit || ':' || filing_radicado AS filing_id, nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, framework, filing_radicado, total_assets_cop, _reject_reason
FROM checked
WHERE _reject_reason IS NOT NULL

name: int_identity
description: Company identity per (nit, fiscal_year). Resolution order for name and attributes: 1 top-10k record of the same year, 2 cover sheet of the current filing, 3 latest top-10k record of any year, 4 unresolved placeholder. name_source records which rule won.
sql:
-- description: Company identity per (nit, fiscal_year). Resolution order for name and attributes: 1 top-10k record of the same year, 2 cover sheet of the current filing, 3 latest top-10k record of any year, 4 unresolved placeholder. name_source records which rule won.
WITH keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT nit, fiscal_year FROM {{ ref('int_filing_versions') }} WHERE is_current
    UNION
    SELECT nit, fiscal_year FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }}
),
top AS (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year ORDER BY revenue_cop DESC, nit) AS revenue_rank
    FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }}
),
top_latest AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }}
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY nit ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC) = 1
),
cover AS (
    SELECT
        c.nit, c.fiscal_year,
        max(c.value_text) FILTER (WHERE c.attribute = 'company_name') AS company_name,
        NULLIF(lpad(regexp_extract(max(c.value_text) FILTER (WHERE c.attribute = 'ciiu'), '^[A-Z]?([0-9]{4})', 1), 4, '0'), '0000') AS ciiu,
        upper(max(c.value_text) FILTER (WHERE c.attribute = 'department')) AS department,
        max(c.value_text) FILTER (WHERE c.attribute = 'city') AS city
    FROM {{ ref('stg_niif_caratula') }} c
    JOIN {{ ref('int_filing_versions') }} v
      ON v.nit = c.nit AND v.fiscal_year = c.fiscal_year AND v.filing_radicado = c.filing_radicado
    WHERE v.is_current
    GROUP BY c.nit, c.fiscal_year, c.filing_radicado
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.nit, c.fiscal_year ORDER BY c.filing_radicado DESC) = 1
),
resolved AS (
    SELECT
        k.nit, k.fiscal_year,
        coalesce(t.company_name, cv.company_name, tl.company_name, 'NIT ' || k.nit) AS company_name,
        CASE
            WHEN t.company_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'top10k'
            WHEN cv.company_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'caratula'
            WHEN tl.company_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'top10k_other_year'
            ELSE 'unresolved'
        END AS name_source,
        coalesce(t.ciiu, cv.ciiu, tl.ciiu) AS ciiu,
        t.macrosector AS top_macrosector, tl.macrosector AS latest_macrosector,
        coalesce(t.department, cv.department, tl.department) AS department,
        coalesce(t.city, cv.city, tl.city) AS city,
        t.region AS top_region, tl.region AS latest_region,
        t.nit IS NOT NULL AS in_top10k,
        t.revenue_rank AS top10k_rank
    FROM keys k
    LEFT JOIN top t ON t.nit = k.nit AND t.fiscal_year = k.fiscal_year
    LEFT JOIN top_latest tl ON tl.nit = k.nit
    LEFT JOIN cover cv ON cv.nit = k.nit AND cv.fiscal_year = k.fiscal_year
)
SELECT
    r.nit, r.fiscal_year, r.company_name, r.name_source,
    r.ciiu, d.section AS ciiu_section,
    coalesce(r.top_macrosector, r.latest_macrosector, sm.macrosector, 'SIN CLASIFICAR') AS macrosector,
    r.department, r.city,
    coalesce(r.top_region, dr.region, r.latest_region, 'SIN CLASIFICAR') AS region,
    r.in_top10k, r.top10k_rank
FROM resolved r
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('seed_ciiu_division') }} d ON d.division = substr(r.ciiu, 1, 2)
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_section_macrosector') }} sm ON sm.section = d.section
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_department_region') }} dr ON dr.department = upper(r.department)

name: int_identity_match_report
description: Identity match report. Counts how each NIT-year was resolved and how well the two Supersociedades sources agree on the same company.
sql:
-- description: Identity match report. Counts how each NIT-year was resolved and how well the two Supersociedades sources agree on the same company.
WITH niif_scope AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT nit, fiscal_year FROM {{ ref('int_filing_versions') }}
    WHERE is_current AND statement_scope IN ('individual', 'separate')
),
cover AS (
    SELECT c.nit, c.fiscal_year, max(c.value_text) FILTER (WHERE c.attribute = 'company_name') AS company_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_niif_caratula') }} c
    JOIN {{ ref('int_filing_versions') }} v ON v.nit = c.nit AND v.fiscal_year = c.fiscal_year AND v.filing_radicado = c.filing_radicado AND v.is_current
    GROUP BY c.nit, c.fiscal_year, c.filing_radicado
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.nit, c.fiscal_year ORDER BY c.filing_radicado DESC) = 1
)
SELECT fiscal_year, 'name_source:' || name_source AS check_id, 'NIT-years whose name was resolved by this rule' AS description,
       count(*) AS n, sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year) AS of_n
FROM {{ ref('int_identity') }}
GROUP BY fiscal_year, name_source
UNION ALL
SELECT t.fiscal_year, 'top10k_found_in_niif', 'Top-10k NIT-years that also have a current individual or separate NIIF filing',
       count(s.nit), count(*)
FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }} t LEFT JOIN niif_scope s ON s.nit = t.nit AND s.fiscal_year = t.fiscal_year
GROUP BY t.fiscal_year
UNION ALL
SELECT t.fiscal_year, 'top10k_missing_outside_supersociedades', 'Top-10k NIT-years without a NIIF filing whose supervisor is not Supersociedades (explains the gap by scope of the dataset)',
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.supervisor <> 'SUPERSOCIEDADES'), count(*)
FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }} t LEFT JOIN niif_scope s ON s.nit = t.nit AND s.fiscal_year = t.fiscal_year
WHERE s.nit IS NULL
GROUP BY t.fiscal_year
UNION ALL
SELECT t.fiscal_year, 'name_agreement', 'Companies present in both sources whose names agree on letters and digits (a lossy "?" in the cover sheet matches any run of characters)',
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_replace(upper(strip_accents(t.company_name)), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')
                        LIKE regexp_replace(regexp_replace(upper(c.company_name), '\?+', '%', 'g'), '[^A-Z0-9%]', '', 'g')),
       count(*)
FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }} t JOIN cover c ON c.nit = t.nit AND c.fiscal_year = t.fiscal_year
GROUP BY t.fiscal_year

name: int_macro_year
description: Macroeconomic series by fiscal year. IPC is the December index (base Dec 2018 = 100) with its year-over-year change; TRM is the calendar-day average and the rate in force on 31 December.
sql:
-- description: Macroeconomic series by fiscal year. IPC is the December index (base Dec 2018 = 100) with its year-over-year change; TRM is the calendar-day average and the rate in force on 31 December.
WITH years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM {{ ref('stg_niif_facts') }}
),
ipc AS (
    SELECT year AS fiscal_year, ipc_index AS ipc_dec_index,
           ipc_index / lag(ipc_index) OVER (ORDER BY year) - 1 AS inflation_dec_yoy
    FROM {{ ref('stg_ipc_index') }}
    WHERE month = 12
),
daily AS (
    SELECT d::DATE AS day, arg_max(trm_cop, valid_from) AS trm_cop
    FROM (SELECT trm_cop, valid_from, unnest(generate_series(valid_from, valid_to, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS d FROM {{ ref('stg_trm') }})
    GROUP BY d::DATE
),
trm AS (
    SELECT year(day) AS fiscal_year,
           (sum(trm_cop::DECIMAL(18, 4)) / count(*))::DOUBLE AS trm_avg,
           count(*) AS trm_days,
           max(trm_cop) FILTER (WHERE month(day) = 12 AND day(day) = 31) AS trm_dec31
    FROM daily
    GROUP BY year(day)
)
SELECT y.fiscal_year, i.ipc_dec_index, i.inflation_dec_yoy, t.trm_avg, t.trm_dec31, t.trm_days
FROM years y
LEFT JOIN ipc i USING (fiscal_year)
LEFT JOIN trm t USING (fiscal_year)

columns.name: trm_avg
columns.description: Calendar-day average TRM of the year.

FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }} t

name: company_year
description: Company financial profile. One row per NIT, fiscal year and statement scope: identity, current filing, statement lines in COP, ratios, real growth (IPC) and USD revenue (TRM).
sql:
-- description: Company financial profile. One row per NIT, fiscal year and statement scope: identity, current filing, statement lines in COP, ratios, real growth (IPC) and USD revenue (TRM).
WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        l.*,
        coalesce(l.total_liabilities, l.total_assets - l.total_equity) AS total_liabilities_final,
        l.total_liabilities IS NULL AND l.total_assets IS NOT NULL AND l.total_equity IS NOT NULL AS liabilities_derived
    FROM {{ ref('int_company_lines') }} l
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        l.nit, i.company_name, i.name_source, l.framework, l.statement_scope,
        i.ciiu, i.ciiu_section, i.macrosector, i.department, i.city, i.region,
        l.fiscal_year, l.filing_id, v.filing_radicado, v.n_versions,
        l.revenue, l.cost_of_sales, l.gross_profit, l.admin_expenses, l.selling_expenses, l.operating_income,
        l.finance_income, l.finance_costs, l.profit_before_tax, l.income_tax, l.net_income,
        l.total_assets, l.current_assets, l.cash, l.receivables, l.inventories, l.ppe,
        l.total_liabilities_final AS total_liabilities, l.liabilities_derived,
        l.current_liabilities,
        coalesce(l.noncurrent_liabilities, CASE WHEN l.current_liabilities IS NOT NULL THEN l.total_liabilities_final - l.current_liabilities END) AS noncurrent_liabilities,
        l.noncurrent_liabilities IS NULL AND l.current_liabilities IS NOT NULL AND l.total_liabilities_final IS NOT NULL AS noncurrent_derived,
        l.total_equity, l.operating_cash_flow, l.revenue_prior,
        i.in_top10k, i.top10k_rank,
        m.inflation_dec_yoy, m.trm_avg, m.ipc_dec_index,
        (SELECT ipc_dec_index FROM {{ ref('int_macro_year') }} WHERE fiscal_year = 2024) AS ipc_dec_2024
    FROM lines l
    JOIN {{ ref('int_filing_versions') }} v ON v.filing_id = l.filing_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_identity') }} i ON i.nit = l.nit AND i.fiscal_year = l.fiscal_year
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_macro_year') }} m ON m.fiscal_year = l.fiscal_year
)
SELECT
    nit, company_name, name_source, framework, statement_scope, ciiu, ciiu_section, macrosector, department, city, region,
    fiscal_year, filing_id, filing_radicado,
    revenue, cost_of_sales, gross_profit, admin_expenses, selling_expenses, operating_income,
    finance_income, finance_costs, profit_before_tax, income_tax, net_income,
    total_assets, current_assets, cash, receivables, inventories, ppe,
    total_liabilities, current_liabilities, noncurrent_liabilities, total_equity, operating_cash_flow,
    CASE WHEN revenue > 0 THEN gross_profit / revenue END AS gross_margin,
    CASE WHEN revenue > 0 THEN operating_income / revenue END AS operating_margin,
    CASE WHEN revenue > 0 THEN net_income / revenue END AS net_margin,
    CASE WHEN total_assets > 0 THEN net_income / total_assets END AS roa,
    CASE WHEN total_equity > 0 THEN net_income / total_equity END AS roe,
    CASE WHEN current_liabilities > 0 THEN current_assets / current_liabilities END AS current_ratio,
    CASE WHEN total_assets > 0 THEN total_liabilities / total_assets END AS debt_ratio,
    CASE WHEN total_equity > 0 THEN total_assets / total_equity END AS equity_multiplier,
    CASE WHEN revenue_prior > 0 AND revenue IS NOT NULL THEN revenue / revenue_prior - 1 END AS revenue_growth_nominal,
    CASE WHEN revenue_prior > 0 AND revenue IS NOT NULL THEN (revenue / revenue_prior) / (1 + inflation_dec_yoy) - 1 END AS revenue_growth_real,
    revenue / trm_avg AS revenue_usd,
    revenue * ipc_dec_2024 / ipc_dec_index AS revenue_real_2024_cop,
    in_top10k, top10k_rank,
    CASE WHEN NOT liabilities_derived AND total_assets IS NOT NULL AND total_liabilities IS NOT NULL AND total_equity IS NOT NULL
         THEN abs(total_assets - total_liabilities - total_equity) <= 3000 + 0.0001 * abs(total_assets) END AS balance_check_ok,
    list_filter([
        CASE WHEN NOT liabilities_derived AND total_assets IS NOT NULL AND total_liabilities IS NOT NULL AND total_equity IS NOT NULL
              AND abs(total_assets - total_liabilities - total_equity) > 3000 + 0.0001 * abs(total_assets) THEN 'balance_mismatch' END,
        CASE WHEN liabilities_derived THEN 'liabilities_derived' END,
        CASE WHEN noncurrent_derived THEN 'noncurrent_liabilities_derived' END,
        CASE WHEN revenue IS NULL THEN 'missing_revenue' END,
        CASE WHEN revenue < 0 THEN 'negative_revenue' END,
        CASE WHEN total_assets IS NULL THEN 'missing_assets' END,
        CASE WHEN total_equity < 0 THEN 'negative_equity' END,
        CASE WHEN total_assets > 0 AND revenue > 1000 * total_assets THEN 'implausible_revenue_to_assets' END,
        CASE WHEN name_source = 'unresolved' THEN 'name_unresolved' END,
        CASE WHEN n_versions > 1 THEN 'resubmitted_filing' END
    ], lambda x: x IS NOT NULL)::VARCHAR[] AS quality_flags
FROM joined

name: reconciliation
description: NIIF statements versus the 10,000-largest dataset for the same NIT-year. The top-10k figures are rounded to 0.01 trillion COP (1e10), so the tolerance is half that unit plus the 1000 COP NIIF reporting unit. Individual statements are compared first, separate ones when no individual exists.
sql:
-- description: NIIF statements versus the 10,000-largest dataset for the same NIT-year. The top-10k figures are rounded to 0.01 trillion COP (1e10), so the tolerance is half that unit plus the 1000 COP NIIF reporting unit. Individual statements are compared first, separate ones when no individual exists.
WITH niif AS (
    SELECT nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, revenue, net_income, total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity
    FROM {{ ref('company_year') }}
    WHERE statement_scope IN ('individual', 'separate')
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY nit, fiscal_year ORDER BY CASE statement_scope WHEN 'individual' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) = 1
),
paired AS (
    SELECT t.nit, t.fiscal_year, n.statement_scope, m.metric, m.niif_value, m.top10k_value
    FROM {{ ref('stg_top10k') }} t
    LEFT JOIN niif n ON n.nit = t.nit AND n.fiscal_year = t.fiscal_year
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        ('revenue', n.revenue, t.revenue_cop),
        ('net_income', n.net_income, t.net_income_cop),
        ('total_assets', n.total_assets, t.total_assets_cop),
        ('total_liabilities', n.total_liabilities, t.total_liabilities_cop),
        ('total_equity', n.total_equity, t.total_equity_cop)
    ) AS m(metric, niif_value, top10k_value)
)
SELECT
    nit, fiscal_year, statement_scope, metric,
    niif_value::DOUBLE AS value_niif_cop,
    top10k_value::DOUBLE AS value_top10k_cop,
    abs(niif_value - top10k_value)::DOUBLE AS abs_diff_cop,
    5000001000::DOUBLE AS tolerance_cop,
    CASE
        WHEN niif_value IS NULL OR top10k_value IS NULL THEN 'missing_side'
        WHEN round(niif_value / 1e10) * 1e10 = top10k_value THEN 'match'
        WHEN abs(niif_value - top10k_value) <= 5000001000 THEN 'within_rounding'
        ELSE 'mismatch'
    END AS status
FROM paired

name: restatements
description: Restated comparatives. Where the comparative column ("Periodo Anterior") of the next year's current filing differs from the value originally reported for that year by more than the 1000 COP reporting unit (smaller differences are rounding, not restatement).
sql:
-- description: Restated comparatives. Where the comparative column ("Periodo Anterior") of the next year's current filing differs from the value originally reported for that year by more than the 1000 COP reporting unit (smaller differences are rounding, not restatement).
SELECT
    o.nit, o.fiscal_year, o.statement_scope, o.line AS concept,
    o.value_cop AS original_value,
    r.value_cop AS restated_value,
    r.value_cop - o.value_cop AS delta,
    o.filing_id AS original_filing_id,
    r.filing_id AS restating_filing_id
FROM {{ ref('int_filing_lines') }} o
JOIN {{ ref('int_filing_lines') }} r
  ON r.nit = o.nit AND r.statement_scope = o.statement_scope AND r.fiscal_year = o.fiscal_year + 1 AND r.line = o.line
WHERE o.period_kind = 'current' AND r.period_kind = 'prior' AND abs(r.value_cop - o.value_cop) > 1000

columns.description: Value in the current period of the original filing, COP.

columns.name: restated_value
columns.description: Value in the comparative column of the later filing, COP.

columns.description: Later filing carrying the restated comparative.

name: sector_year
description: Sector aggregates. One row per macrosector, fiscal year and statement scope. Totals are exact integer sums; percentiles are linear-interpolated quantiles of the per-company ratios.
sql:
-- description: Sector aggregates. One row per macrosector, fiscal year and statement scope. Totals are exact integer sums; percentiles are linear-interpolated quantiles of the per-company ratios.
SELECT
    macrosector, fiscal_year, statement_scope,
    count(*) AS companies,
    sum(revenue::BIGINT)::DOUBLE AS revenue_total,
    sum(net_income::BIGINT)::DOUBLE AS net_income_total,
    quantile_cont(net_margin, 0.25) AS net_margin_p25,
    quantile_cont(net_margin, 0.50) AS net_margin_p50,
    quantile_cont(net_margin, 0.75) AS net_margin_p75,
    quantile_cont(debt_ratio, 0.25) AS debt_ratio_p25,
    quantile_cont(debt_ratio, 0.50) AS debt_ratio_p50,
    quantile_cont(debt_ratio, 0.75) AS debt_ratio_p75
FROM {{ ref('company_year') }}
GROUP BY macrosector, fiscal_year, statement_scope

columns.description: Sum of net income in COP (exact integer sum).
